name: merchant-growth-task-acceptance
description: 商家成长任务体系 · 根级统一验收编排（仅编排，不参与构建）

scripts.verify: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:admin && npm run verify:h5 && npm run verify:db && npm run test:api
scripts.verify:backend: cd api-py && uv run python -m compileall -q app && uv run python -c "import app.main"
scripts.verify:db: cd api-py && uv run python scripts/check_schema.py && uv run python scripts/check_data_encoding.py && uv run python scripts/check_orphan.py && uv run alembic current
